redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/merge.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: no tally or error reader matched its output, so no line of it is quoted as decisive; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD; no ignored dependency directory linked from the project root; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home); deadline: 480s, the default - the command is not a sweep naming suites, so there is no recorded cost to size it from

outcome.technical: The brief file was not on disk (drive-phase brief exited 2: no executor brief written for P10.9-6rm's current start), so I worked from the task text in the manifest and the caller's message and explored the code myself. scripts/merge.mjs: added evidenceReader(repo, commit) (git at meta.commit, mirrors validate.mjs line count and directory semantics; null when no repo, not git, or commit unknown) and normaliseEvidence(). merge() now, right after fragments are placed and before the dangling-reference pass, clamps evidence ranges past EOF (end to last line; start past end to last line), drops entries whose path is not a file (or is an empty file) at the commit, drops a node or edge left without evidence (the existing dropped-ref pass then removes edges, entities and access rows pointing at a dropped node), and records one meta.sources row {area,type:'clamped-evidence'|'dropped-evidence',id,path,note} per change. Only elements from this run's fragments are touched; elements kept from --previous are left to validate. merge() returns evidenceChecked; the CLI validates with {repo} when evidence was checked (exit 1 only over remaining findings, listed as 'invalid:' lines), else validates as before and prints 'merge: evidence not checked: ...' on stderr when --repo was given. validate.mjs was not edited (its git helper is not exported; the line-count logic is mirrored in merge.mjs). tests/merge.test.mjs: m20-m20f against a throwaway git repo built at test time. Full suite node --test: 361 pass, 0 fail; node --test tests/denylist.test.mjs: 2 pass. Not done: sequences/views kept from --previous that name a dropped node are not pruned (validate would report a dangling-ref); the caller's design.md and README were not touched.
outcome.descriptive: merge normalises evidence it can check against the repository (clamp, drop) and runs validate --repo itself, so one out-of-range citation no longer loses a build.

testsAdded: m20 clamp of ranges past EOF with clamped-evidence rows (nodes, edges, entity field, access)
m20b dropped entries (missing path, directory), dropped node and edge, dropped-ref cascade, validate --repo clean
m20c CLI exit 0 on the fixture validate --repo refused, validate.mjs --repo accepts the output
m20d lines checked at meta.commit not the working tree
m20e exit 1 only over un-normalised findings (kept --previous element), listed, nothing written
m20f byte-identical across runs and fragment order; unresolvable commit leaves evidence alone with a stderr note
